vocabulary.meaning_en: the thing you talk or write about

vocabulary.meaning_en: a subject that you talk or write about

vocabulary.meaning_en: after the usual or expected time

vocabulary.meaning_en: a teacher at a university

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small tool that makes a pencil sharp

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take something and give it back later

vocabulary.meaning_en: more than you usually need

vocabulary.meaning_en: a little afraid or worried

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: لا تُجمع: نقول some advice وليس advices

vocabulary.meaning_en: to listen or watch carefully

vocabulary.meaning_en: to try as hard as you can

vocabulary.meaning_en: a first version of a piece of writing

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tall African animal with a very long neck

vocabulary.meaning_en: a storm with a lot of snow and wind

vocabulary.meaning_en: calmly, without getting angry when you wait

vocabulary.meaning_en: to speak about a subject in front of people

vocabulary.meaning_en: an answer to a problem
vocabulary.example: We need a solution to this problem.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something difficult that needs to be fixed
vocabulary.example: Traffic is a problem in big cities.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a feeling that good things will happen
vocabulary.example: Good news fills us with hope.

fine_lines.title: for vs since
fine_lines.explanation_ar: for + مدة (for 10 minutes, for a long time, for several years). since + نقطة البداية (since 2015, since last night, since Monday).
fine_lines.explanation_en: for + a period of time (for 10 minutes, for a long time, for several years). since + the starting point (since 2015, since last night, since Monday).

examples.sentence: We've been waiting for about 10 minutes.
I have been writing since last night.

fine_lines.title: borrow vs lend
fine_lines.explanation_ar: borrow = تأخذ شيئًا من شخص لتعيده لاحقًا. lend = تعطي شيئًا لشخص ليعيده لك. Can I borrow your pen? = Can you lend me your pen?
fine_lines.explanation_en: Borrow = take something from someone and give it back later. Lend = give something to someone for a short time. "Can I borrow your pen?" = "Can you lend me your pen?"

examples.sentence: Do you have a pencil sharpener I can borrow?
Can you lend me your pencil sharpener?

expressions.phrase: Are you finished with your report?
expressions.example: Are you finished with your homework?

expressions.meaning_en: asking if you came after the start time
expressions.example: Am I late? Has the class started?

expressions.meaning_en: it's OK; there is no problem

expressions.phrase: How long has the class been waiting?
expressions.meaning_en: asking about the length of time of an action
expressions.example: How long have you been waiting?

expressions.phrase: Do you have a … I can borrow?

expressions.example: Do you have a pen I can borrow?
Whew, that was close. I almost missed the train.
Don't be nervous. You know the answers.

expressions.phrase: Just pay attention and do your best!
expressions.example: Just pay attention and do your best in the exam!
Everyone is here. Let's get started!

grammar.title: Present perfect continuous: have/has been + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar:
نستخدم المضارع التام المستمر لفعل بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمرًا حتى الآن، مع التركيز على المدة.
التركيب: have/has + been + الفعل + ing.
• I have been writing since last night.
• We've been waiting for about 10 minutes.
• Students have been studying here since 1792.
السؤال عن المدة: How long have you been + ing? → How long have you been studying at Georgetown?
النفي: I haven't been sleeping well.
grammar.explanation_en:
Use the present perfect continuous for an action that started in the past and is still going on now. It focuses on how long.
Form: have/has + been + verb-ing.
• I have been writing since last night.
• We've been waiting for about 10 minutes.
• Students have been studying here since 1792.
Ask about time: How long have you been + verb-ing? → How long have you been studying at Georgetown?
Negative: I haven't been sleeping well.
examples: How long have you been studying at Georgetown?
We've only been waiting for about 10 minutes.
I've been working for several years now.
I've been wanting to go back to school for a long time.

questions.question: Complete: "I've been studying here ___ 2015."
questions.explanation_en: Use "since" with a starting point: since 2015.

questions.question: Complete: "We've been waiting ___ about 10 minutes."
questions.explanation_en: Use "for" with a period of time.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
choices: How long you have been studying?
How long have you being studying?
How long have you been studying?
How long are you been studying?
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال: How long + have + you + been + ing?
questions.explanation_en: The question form is: How long + have + you + been + verb-ing?

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She have been writing since last night.
She has be writing since last night.
She is been writing since last night.
She has been writing since last night.
questions.explanation_ar: مع she نقول has been + ing.

questions.question: What is a "draft"?
choices: a first version of a piece of writing
questions.explanation_ar: draft = مسودة، النسخة الأولى من الكتابة.
questions.explanation_en: A draft is the first version of a piece of writing.

questions.question: "Violence" means …
questions.explanation_ar: violence = العنف، أي أفعال تؤذي الناس.
questions.explanation_en: Violence is actions that hurt people.

questions.question: Which is correct?
choices: Can I lend your pencil sharpener?
Can I borrow your pencil sharpener?
Can you borrow me your pencil sharpener?
Can I borrowing your pencil sharpener?
questions.explanation_ar: نأخذ الشيء → borrow: Can I borrow …?
questions.explanation_en: When you take something, use "borrow": Can I borrow …?

questions.question: Someone tells you: "Pay attention and do your best!" This is …
questions.explanation_en: This is advice: an idea about what you should do.

questions.question: You almost missed the bus, but you caught it. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: That was close = كاد أن يحدث شيء سيئ.
questions.explanation_en: "That was close" means something bad almost happened.
